name: filter_scsi_532_3nm
label: SCSI 532 nm filter, FWHM 3.0 nm
sources: Horch et al. 2026, arXiv:2601.13447 (SCSI paper II): narrow bandpass filter, usually 532 nm with FWHM 1.2 nm; 532/3.0 nm earlier
notes: The earlier filter (Paper I and 2017 Jun 21): FWHM 3.0 nm.

Top-hat of the stated FWHM; the true profile and peak transmission are not given in the paper. Throughput 0.9 as for the other single filters; the telescope throughput is calibrated against the count rate with this value.
Coherence time 0.79 ps (1.2 nm) or 0.31 ps (3 nm), far below the 48 ps timing: the band width sets the count rate, not the g2 width.
